name: EventCard
title: EventCard
summary: Two sibling cards for what is happening at ISM: an event card with a date tile, type badge, time and place, and a news card with a photo, category badge, date and Read the story link.
whenToUse: Event `.mn-event`: prayer nights, launches, webinars and conferences with a date to register for.
News `.mn-news`: field stories, announcements and press items.
Use them side by side in a "What's happening" grid; give cards in a row equal height.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for giving campaigns; use DonationWidget with goal progress.

props.name: month
props.description: Month abbreviation on the date tile, e.g. "NOV". Decorative.

props.name: day
props.description: Day of month on the date tile, e.g. "12". Decorative.

props.name: badge
props.description: Type badge text, e.g. "Online event". One badge per card.

props.name: title
props.description: Event title that names the gathering.

props.name: dateText
props.description: Time row: day, date, time with zone, length, e.g. "Thursday, Nov 12 · 7:00 pm ET · 90 min".

props.name: place
props.description: Place row, e.g. "Online · link sent after you register".

props.name: description
props.description: One-sentence summary, two lines at most.

props.name: href
props.description: Register URL. Opens another page, so the label ends with ↗.

props.name: footNote
props.description: Text beside the action, e.g. "212 going (sample)". Mark invented counts as samples.

variantNotes: Event: 64 × 68px `.mn-datetile` (month 12px 700 in `--horizon-blue`, day 26px 600); type badge `.badge-info` (Online event) or another base badge for in-person.
Footers sit at the bottom (`margin-top:auto`) so a row of cards lines up.
Cards use base `.card` hover and focus.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Both actions go to another page, so both end with ↗: `.btn-secondary btn-sm` "Register" on events, `.btn-ghost btn-sm` "Read the story" on news.
No Horizon Blue filled button inside these cards; the page's primary action lives elsewhere.
Event meta rows: time first (day, date, time with zone, length), then place. Always include the time zone.
One badge per card. One-sentence summary, two lines at most.
Mark invented counts as samples ("212 going (sample)").
Use only system imagery; news photos need real alt text.

accessibility: Use `<time datetime>` for every date and time.
The date tile is `aria-hidden="true"`; the meta row carries the full date for screen readers.
Each card is an `<article>` with an `h3` title; meta icons are `aria-hidden="true"`.
Link text names the action; add the title as visually hidden text when several cards say "Read the story".
content: Event title names the gathering: "Global prayer night for Bible translation".
Time: "Thursday, Nov 12 · 7:00 pm ET · 90 min". Place: "Online · link sent after you register".
News title is a plain headline in sentence case: "An audio Bible in Amharic reaches 40 radio stations".
